observableChecks: At least one contract covers explicit rendering of user-supplied handoff checklist items.
At least one negative activation region excludes project management, delivery decisions, status investigation, prioritization, assignment, communication, or execution.
Required effects preserve supplied id, action, complete, and optional owner values, preserve input order and repeated identifiers, and separate invalid entries with field-specific reasons.
Prohibited effects include inferred completion or ownership, priority, readiness, delivery decisions, communication, and checklist modification.
Responsibility boundaries prohibit project files, issue trackers, calendars, messages, deployment systems, and other external state.
Blocking unresolved requirements preserve absent decision thresholds, target usage distribution, severe-harm limits, or required uncertainty rather than inventing them.
Controlled schema, identity, snapshot, lifecycle, and provenance fields remain system-owned and the completed Blueprint remains decision-ineligible.
Every identifier is derived from observable authored content rather than hidden expected state.
terminalFailureConditions: Missing observable contract or activation boundary
